hooks.name: Pre-Task-Completion Checks
hooks.description: Before a spec task is marked completed, verifies scaffolded tests, data validation, formatting, types, CDK synthesis, tracked secrets, and documentation review (Kiro University Lesson 3, Hook D).

action.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'; function Invoke-Checked { param([scriptblock]$Command) & $Command; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\backend'); Invoke-Checked { python -m pytest tests -q }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru'); Invoke-Checked { python data/scripts/validate.py }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\frontend'); Invoke-Checked { npm run format:check }; Invoke-Checked { npm run lint }; Invoke-Checked { npm run typecheck }; Invoke-Checked { npm test }; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\infra'); Invoke-Checked { python -m pytest tests -q }; Invoke-Checked { cdk synth }; Set-Location $root; Invoke-Checked { git diff --check }; $secretPattern = '(?i)(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|aws_secret_access_key\s*[:=]|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36})'; $matches = git grep -n -I -E $secretPattern -- ':!*.example' ':!.kiro/hooks/pre-completion-checks.json'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Error ('Potential tracked secret: ' + ($matches -join '; ')); exit 1 }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 1) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host 'Pre-completion checks passed. Review changed documentation before marking the task complete.'
